nodes.description: Private mapping _balances of ERC20 tracking token balances per address.
Private nested mapping _allowed of ERC20 tracking allowances owner=>spender=>amount.
Private uint256 _totalSupply holding the total token supply.
Constant string name of the RemiToken ('Remitano Token').
Constant string symbol of the RemiToken ('RET').
Constant uint8 decimals of the token (18).
Constant uint256 INITIAL_SUPPLY used as mint amount in the constructor.
SafeMath.mul: multiplies two uint256 values reverting on overflow.
SafeMath.div: integer division reverting on division by zero.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction reverting if subtrahend greater than minuend.
SafeMath.add: addition reverting on overflow.
SafeMath.mod: modulo operation reverting when divisor is zero.
ERC20.totalSupply: returns the stored _totalSupply.
ERC20.balanceOf: returns the balance of a given owner from _balances.
ERC20.allowance: returns remaining allowance for a spender from _allowed.
ERC20.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to', updating _balances with add/sub.
ERC20.approve: sets _allowed[msg.sender][spender] to value and emits Approval.
ERC20.transferFrom: moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using and decrementing the allowance.
ERC20.increaseAllowance: increases spender allowance by addedValue.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance: decreases spender allowance by subtractedValue.
ERC20._mint: internal mint that increases _totalSupply and recipient balance and emits Transfer.
RemiToken constructor: mints INITIAL_SUPPLY tokens to msg.sender.
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and minting.
Arithmetic: _balances[msg.sender].sub(value) in transfer (SafeMath guarded subtraction).
Arithmetic: _balances[to].add(value) in transfer (SafeMath guarded addition).
Arithmetic: _balances[from].sub(value) in transferFrom.
Arithmetic: _balances[to].add(value) in transferFrom.
Arithmetic: _allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(value) in transferFrom.
Arithmetic: _allowed[msg.sender][spender].add(addedValue) in increaseAllowance.
Arithmetic: _allowed[msg.sender][spender].sub(subtractedValue) in decreaseAllowance.
Arithmetic: _totalSupply.add(amount) inside _mint.
Arithmetic: _balances[account].add(amount) inside _mint.
Arithmetic: c = a * b with require(c / a == b) overflow check in SafeMath.mul.
Arithmetic: a % b remainder after require(b != 0) in SafeMath.mod.
Local variable c holding the multiplication result in SafeMath.mul.
Local variable c holding the division result in SafeMath.div.
Local variable c holding the subtraction result in SafeMath.sub.
Local variable c holding the addition result in SafeMath.add.

Parameter b of SafeMath.add (second addend).
Parameter to of ERC20.transfer (recipient address).

Parameter value of ERC20.approve (allowance amount).
Parameter from of ERC20.transferFrom (source address).
Parameter to of ERC20.transferFrom (destination address).
Parameter value of ERC20.transferFrom (amount moved).
Parameter spender of ERC20.increaseAllowance.
Parameter addedValue of ERC20.increaseAllowance.
Parameter spender of ERC20.decreaseAllowance.
Parameter subtractedValue of ERC20.decreaseAllowance.
Parameter account of ERC20._mint (recipient of minted tokens).
Parameter amount of ERC20._mint (tokens created).
